description: Explorer CT Men's 700C Hybrid Bike – Lightweight, Simple, and Stylish The Explorer CT Men’s Hybrid Bike is designed for riders who value a lightweight, simple, and stylish ride. Built with a durable 20-inch aluminum frame, this bike offers the perfect balance of strength and agility. Its sleek matte black finish adds a modern, understated look, making it a standout choice for urban and suburban adventures. Equipped with a Shimano 7-speed gear system, the Explorer CT makes shifting gears smooth and effortless, whether you're navigating flat roads or tackling gentle inclines. The 700C wheelset ensures efficient performance, providing a stable and comfortable ride for commutes, leisure trips, or weekend explorations. This hybrid bike is built to handle city streets and bike paths with ease, offering versatility for everyday use. Designed with an athletic yet comfortable geometry, the bike encourages a confident riding posture that minimizes strain on your back and shoulders. Its ergonomic handlebars and padded saddle enhance comfort, ensuring a pleasant experience on both short and long rides. Whether you’re commuting to work, running errands, or enjoying a scenic ride, the Explorer CT Men’s Hybrid Bike delivers reliable performance and a touch of style. Its lightweight frame and simple design make it a practical choice for men seeking a dependable bike that’s easy to ride and maintain. Frame: XDSBIKE 700C x 20" Aluminum Frame Size: 20" Fork: Steel Tire: Black Kenda 700 x 38 Rim: Alloy Double Wall Spoke: Stainless Steel Chainwheel: Pro Alloy 3 PC Pedal: Resin Body 9/16" R. Derailleur: Shimano 7-Speed Shifter: Shimano SL-RS35 Freewheel: Shimano MF-TZ21 Brake lever: Tektro Alloy Brake: Tektro V Brake Handlebar: Satin Steel Stem: Alloy Grip: Rubber Saddle: Comfort Sport Seat post: Alloy Seat clamp: Alloy Weight of the Bike: 28lbs Fits riders from 5'6" to 6'5" tall
